steps: Open Chase's official page https://creditcards.chase.com/a1/Business0926 and confirm the Ink Business Premier $1,000-after-$10,000 offer is still showing.
Complete the business application (sole proprietorships are eligible); Chase runs a hard inquiry on your personal credit when you apply.
If approved, spend $10,000 on business purchases you were already planning within the first 3 months — do not manufacture spend.
Pay the balance in full — the Flex for Business variable APR (17.74%–28.49%) destroys the bonus.
Redeem the $1,000 as cash back; note the $195 annual fee makes the true net about $805.
timing: Application takes 20–40 min active; then route $10,000 in already-planned business spend through the card within 3 months; $1,000 cash back is redeemable after the threshold; true net ≈ $805 after the $195 fee.
